front.label: Moment ID
front.hint: A unique code such as P07-M03 (participant 7, moment 3), so the card can be cited later without naming anyone.

front.label: Setting
front.hint: Where this happened and who else was present.

front.label: Time
front.hint: Date and clock time, or the timestamp in the recording.

front.label: What was happening
front.hint: The situation just before and during the moment, in plain words.

front.label: Exact words (original language)
front.hint: The words as spoken, in the language spoken, including code-switches and exclamations such as “arre” or “haye”. Do not translate them here.

front.label: What was observed
front.hint: Gesture, expression, tone, pause, or action: what you could see or hear, not what you concluded.

front.label: Researcher’s guess at meaning
front.hint: Your inference, written down as a guess. It is not a finding until the back of the card says it is.

back.label: What was asked to confirm
back.hint: The question you actually asked the participant, in the language you asked it.

back.label: Participant’s explanation
back.hint: Their answer in their own words, in their own language.

back.label: Correction status
back.hint: Did the participant confirm your guess, correct it, disagree with it, or has it not been checked yet?

back.label: Another possible meaning
back.hint: A rival reading you cannot yet rule out. Writing it down keeps the first reading from hardening.

back.label: Translation review flag
back.flagText: A language collaborator still needs to check the translation
back.hint: Tick if the rendering has not yet been reviewed by a local language collaborator.

back.label: Sensitive to reuse
back.flagText: Quoting or sharing this could expose the participant
back.hint: Tick if quoting, sharing, or design use of this moment could expose the participant or their family. It stays inside the research team.

fidelityColumns.label: Single-source flag (second reader agrees? yes / no)
